notes:
Summary: mid-market CCaaS provider building an agent-assist and ticket summarization layer for enterprise customers. High interest in streaming suggestions (live inline hints) and deterministic guardrails.

Key requirements (from discovery + SOW draft):
- Realtime suggestions to agent UI: avg RTT goal ~ <120ms, p95 <200ms under normal load; must maintain under 3x traffic spikes during promos.
- Streaming partials (token-level or phrase-level) to reduce perceived latency.
- Tool-calling integration: CRM (Zendesk), internal ticketing, and a voice-platform webhook (Genesys). Need examples of function calling / structured tool outputs.
- Strong guardrails: hallucination mitigation, deterministic citation to KB, automatic redaction of PII, and human-in-loop escalation.
- Security: corporate SSO/SAML, audit logs for every suggestion, KMS-managed keys for tokenization, data residency US/EU option, retention policy controls.

Model / routing preferences and heuristics:
- Prefer smaller quantized open model for low-latency inline suggestions; fallback to larger model for complex dialog summarization and reranking.
- Want smart routing by policy: latency-first for live suggestions, cost-fallback for after-call summarization.
- KV prefix caching for repeated KB lookups; explicit cache invalidation hooks via webhook.

POC success criteria (customer):
- Streaming suggestions appear in agent UI within avg <120ms and p95 <200ms under 2x daily traffic; survive synthetic 3x spike with graceful degradation.
- Accurate summarization baseline: F1 > 0.78 vs labeled transcripts on pilot set.
- No PII leakage; redaction pipeline validates on sample logs.
- Integration: successful tool-call roundtrips to Zendesk and Genesys staging.

Quoted from CISO: "We need full auditability on suggestions and the ability to revoke keys from our side."
